title: Evaluate red delete and green selection feedback and compare alternatives
scope: Review selected 2026-11-06, including color blindness and Android guidance. User accepted retaining red/green with non-color cues and selected UI-028 for implementation. Original review artifacts are preserved separately from the application fix.
request: Analyze whether red warning feedback for deletion and green feedback for selection are good choices, or whether better alternatives exist.
expected: A justified recommendation to retain or change the current action-color treatment, with alternatives compared for clarity, accessibility, theme compatibility, and one-handed shopping use.
current_implementation: TextDelegate.qml uses Material.Red for the edit-mode right-swipe delete background and Material.Green for shopping-mode selection and the opposite swipe background. The feedback is translucent and accompanied by action icons.
review_topics: Whether red communicates the destructive delete action clearly and whether green communicates checking/selection appropriately.
How checking, unchecking, and deleting are distinguished, especially when the same swipe direction has a different action in edit mode.
Compare retaining red/green with alternatives such as theme-derived action colors or a different treatment for non-destructive selection. Do not assume a replacement is necessary.
Color-vision accessibility and whether icons or other existing feedback distinguish actions without relying on red versus green alone.
Contrast and action-icon readability over the actual translucent backgrounds in Light, Dark, System, and checked/inverse-theme states.
Whether configurable primary/accent colors conflict with the meaning of the fixed action colors; coordinate with UX-001.
Relevant official Android/Material guidance and the app's deliberate gesture, opacity, and animation design.
acceptance_criteria: Describe the current action-color meanings and their actual rendered appearance.
Compare the current scheme with plausible alternatives, documenting benefits and tradeoffs rather than choosing colors by preference alone.
Evaluate destructive-action clarity, non-color cues, color-vision accessibility, contrast, and theme interactions.
Recommend retaining or changing the scheme with clear reasoning and directly cited guidance where applicable.
Record any proposed implementation work separately; preserve the intended one-handed gestures and do not bundle functional swipe fixes into the color review.
evidence: Explicit user backlog request on 2026-10-28 to evaluate red for delete and green for selection and consider better alternatives.
additional_user_request: 2026-11-06: Include color blindness and check how Android handles it.

review.recommendation: Retain red for deletion and green for check/uncheck, independent of primary/accent. Preserve bin/cart silhouettes, incoming/outgoing arrow animation, strikeout and checked-group context. Do not add a color-blind theme or more pickers; a universal alternative hue pair does not replace non-color cues and readable contrast.
review.android: Official Android principles recommend shapes/text/other cues alongside color. User color correction/grayscale and developer Simulate color space are different features. Android documents that screenshots under its color-space simulator remain normal; future display validation must observe the live display or a validated capture of final displayed output, with original settings restored.
review.rendered: Native Windows window using Qt Quick software rendering: six collection records pass, covering 32 settled combinations (eight action/mode/check/direction states, two themes, two real backgrounds), with idle/moving/settled captures. Opaque body cores are measured against same-location composed backgrounds with the icon hidden. This is measurement collection, not six accessibility passes or Android coverage.
review.findings: Light cart body minima: check 2.274:1, uncheck 2.269:1; some per-state medians are below 3:1. Light bin minimum 2.993:1 is a narrow edge case, with higher medians. Dark sampled bodies stay above 3.49:1. UI-028 records the local contrast candidate; body and arrow must be assessed together before implementation.
review.color_vision: Offline grayscale and severity-100 protanopia/deuteranopia/tritanopia models use linear-sRGB Machado 2009 matrices checked against colorspacious's published implementation. Nominal Red500/Green500 become #a4932e/#a59857 in the deuteranopia preview. Shapes persist, but this is neither Android correction output nor a recognition test with affected users; intermediate severities were not evaluated.
review.alternatives: Compare keeping semantic red/green with blue/orange, theme-driven action colors, extra check/uncheck colors and a separate color-blind theme. Prefer retaining established semantics; alternatives do not inherently solve shape/contrast and could add confusion or combinations.
review.rhi_gap: The new review fixture aborts under D3D11 WARP with an opacity-range assertion, exit -1073740791; an existing native Undo control passes three records. Effective Item opacity is already clamped to 1 even when raw ratio is about 8.735. Probe-side and temporary source-cap trials do not isolate the assertion. Cause remains unresolved; no application crash or opacity-binding defect is claimed. Early offscreen mirrored-bounds failures were probe-only and are excluded from retained measurements.
review.verification: Final native-window/software probe: six passed, zero failures/skips, 17.452 seconds. All 64 tracked QML/templates pass formatter Check; JSON and git diff --check pass. Application files match the committed baseline; no full app suite, APK rebuild or Android launch was performed for this review.
review.remaining: The review recommendation was accepted and UI-028 was selected and subsequently accepted. Native Android held swipes and explicit/System resolution are covered by UI-028. Actual live correction/simulator observation, outdoor use, reduced-motion behavior and recognition by affected users remain outside the review evidence. UX-003 remains deferred.

acceptance: User asked whether the conclusion meant no changes, then selected: ok do 028. Retain action hues and improve local swipe icon contrast under UI-028.

resolution.acceptance: User accepted retaining red/green with non-color cues, selected UI-028, then accepted the fix and requested commit/closure on 2026-11-07.
resolution.summary: Retain established red deletion and green checking/unchecking semantics. Improve local body/arrow contrast under UI-028; no additional color pickers or separate color-blind theme.
resolution.evidence: reviews/UX-002.md and retained original measurements/frames document the baseline, primary guidance, alternatives, offline simulation limits and unresolved synthetic-probe assertion. UI-028 records the subsequent actual-touch Windows/Android regression results.
